Thanks for taking the time to do this.

**What does this change, and why?**

**If it adds or edits a document**

- [ ] Front matter is complete and validates
- [ ] `status` honestly reflects how sure we are
- [ ] `ai_disclosure` is set, and `signed_off_by` names a person
- [ ] Material claims are cited; uncertainty is stated
- [ ] Any clinical claim has named clinical review, or is flagged as needing it
- [ ] No personal health information, and nobody identified who has not agreed
- [ ] Nothing implies government endorsement or institutional partnership

**If it supersedes something**

- [ ] The old document is marked `superseded` rather than deleted or rewritten
- [ ] `supersedes` / `superseded_by` are set on both
- [ ] There is an entry in `updates/`

Not sure about any of this? Open it anyway and we will help.
